test_title: PYST 2: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 25 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Arrange the passage correctly:
(1) Wash your hands with water.
(2) Apply soap and scrub well.
(3) Rinse thoroughly with clean water.
(4) Clean and dry your hands with a clean towel.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__ 
 
• The correct sequence of the steps should follow a logical process for washing hands effectively. 
 
• **Step 1:** Wash your hands with water to remove any loose dirt or particles. 
 
• **Step 2:** Apply soap and scrub well to ensure thorough cleaning and removal of germs. 
 
• **Step 3:** Rinse thoroughly with clean water to wash away the soap and dirt. 
 
• **Step 4:** Dry your hands with a clean towel to complete the process hygienically. 
 
• The correct sequence is **1 - 2 - 3 - 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Following the correct sequence ensures optimal hygiene and prevents the spread of germs.
 
• Skipping steps or rearranging them can lead to incomplete cleaning or contamination.

 

**Coherent process after rearrangement**:

Step 1: Wash your hands with water.
Step 2: Apply soap and scrub well.
Step 3: Rinse thoroughly with clean water.
Step 4: Clean and dry your hands with a clean towel.</div
